eval_dimensions.name: Scope Approval Gate
eval_dimensions.description: After presenting the formatted scoping document, the skill fires AskUserQuestion (Approve / Revise / More research needed / Run PoC) before saving the document or updating Linear — never a plain-text 'Approve this scope?'.

eval_dimensions.name: Slack Forward Detection Gate
eval_dimensions.description: When a Slack thread is part of the input and slack_thread_is_forward reports high/medium confidence that the thread is a forward of an upstream thread, the skill fires AskUserQuestion (provide upstream URL / continue anyway / abort scope) instead of silently treating the thin parent as canonical.

evals.name: Scope approval fires AskUserQuestion after the document is presented
evals.description: After Phase 5 formats and presents the scoping document, the skill fires AskUserQuestion per the ask-scope-approval.md call spec before Phase 6 save/Linear-update.

assertions.signal: AskUserQuestion fires with header 'Scope Review' and options Approve/Revise/More research needed/Run PoC
No inline 'Approve this scoping document?' text substitutes for the tool call
The scope document is not saved and Linear is not updated until AskUserQuestion returns a response

evals.name: Revise re-presents a corrected scope and re-fires the gate
evals.description: Selecting 'Revise' applies the user's corrections and re-presents the scope document, re-firing the approval gate rather than saving the unrevised document.

assertions.signal: No save/Linear-update call runs with the pre-revision document; the gate re-fires after revision

evals.name: Run PoC is offered when the scope contains unverified claims
evals.description: When the scope document contains a claim the agent could not verify by reading the codebase alone, the 'Run PoC' option is present among the gate's choices.
evals.input: /Dev10x:ticket-scope PAY-133 (scope claims 'the plugin loads in a child session', unverified by static reading)

assertions.signal: AskUserQuestion options include 'Run PoC' when the scope depends on an unverified claim

evals.name: High/medium-confidence forward fires the Slack-forward AskUserQuestion
evals.description: When slack_thread_is_forward reports confidence high or medium on the parent message, the skill fires AskUserQuestion before treating the thin parent as canonical source.
evals.input: /Dev10x:ticket-scope (input includes a Slack thread URL; slack_thread_is_forward reports confidence=high)

assertions.signal: slack_thread_is_forward is called after the initial slack_read_thread fetch
AskUserQuestion fires with 'Provide upstream Slack URL (Recommended)' / 'Continue with current thread anyway' / 'Abort scope'
Phase 2 technical research does not proceed using the thin parent thread until the gate resolves

evals.name: Low-confidence forward proceeds without the gate
evals.description: When slack_thread_is_forward reports confidence=low, the skill proceeds directly to Phase 2 without firing the forward-detection gate.
evals.input: /Dev10x:ticket-scope (Slack thread URL present; slack_thread_is_forward reports confidence=low)

assertions.signal: AskUserQuestion is NOT called for the forward-detection dimension; Phase 2 proceeds normally

trigger_evals.description: Queries that should/should-not trigger the ticket-scope skill

should_trigger.rationale: Direct invocation to scope a Linear ticket with technical research

should_trigger.query: scope this ticket before I start implementing
should_trigger.rationale: Pre-implementation scoping intent — the core use case

should_not_trigger.query: scope out this whole multi-ticket project with milestones
this is a brand new domain area, run a DDD workshop first
should_not_trigger.rationale: Use Dev10x:ddd before scoping a new domain area
